mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPI year-over-year growth exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in unemployment rate and payroll growth signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive returns in >60% of cases (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1700 thousand units signals expanding consumer confidence, driving retail demand and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST > 1700 (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 index level indicates manufacturing expansion, improving corporate margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 100 (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.0% quarterly signals economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI rise and stable FEDFUNDS (within 0.5%) indicates inflation without policy response, causing negative equity returns as real rates rise.
failure_condition: Joint signal of CPI rising and FEDFUNDS stable fails to produce negative returns in >60% of cases (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 620,000 million dollars signals consumer spending recovery, boosting corporate revenue and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 620,000 (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).
